programme.title: O Capanga: Vingança
programme.desc: Pat Tate lança-se numa cruzada para vingar a morte violenta do seu amigo durante um assalto, mergulhando no lado negro do Soho nos anos 90.

programme.title: Triângulo
programme.desc: Quando vários amigos partem de férias num iate, estão longe de sonhar com o que lhes vai acontecer: uma tempestade faz virar o barco e eles refugiam-se num navio envelhecido e abandonado, onde alguém parece estar a tentar caçá-los.

programme.title: Toro
programme.desc: Dois irmãos reencontram-se ao fim de dois anos: um deles tem estado preso, o outro roubou um perigoso recetador e agora estão ambos em fuga, juntamente com Diana, a filha menor do último, numa viagem pela Andaluzia violenta, mítica, agreste e selvagem.

programme.title: Os Segredos Que Ocultamos
programme.desc: Nos EUA, após a Segunda Guerra Mundial, uma refugiada romena reconstrói a vida com o marido americano mas ainda continua atormentada pela memória dos horrores do conflito, acabando por raptar um vizinho em busca de vingança pelos crimes de guerra hediondos que ela acredita que ele cometeu.

programme.title: Silk Road: Mercado Clandestino
programme.desc: A história verídica do jovem Ross Ulbricht, que criou o Silk Road, um posto de vendas não regulado na internet que rapidamente serviu de palco a um negócio de tráfico de drogas de milhões de dólares, e da perseguição sem quartel que lhe moveu o imprevisível agente Rick Bowden.

programme.title: Snow - Os Domínios Do Espelho
programme.desc: Certo dia o Rei Harald, que odeia magia, decide isolar todos os Mágicos nos Domínios do Espelho. Desta forma, a última esperança para o Universo da Magia, é Kiara. Ela terá de descobrir os seus verdadeiros poderes e salvar a sua família, todos os mágicos e a própria magia!

programme.title: Triângulo Da Tristeza
programme.desc: Um casal de modelos célebres embarca num cruzeiro luxuoso, com convidados muito ricos que fazem exigências loucas aos empregados, até que o barco naufraga e os passageiros se vêem encalhados numa ilha deserta, onde a hierarquia do barco sofre uma inesperada reviravolta.

programme.title: Cai Na Real, Corgi
programme.desc: Rex é um cão de raça Corgi, o mais amado pela rainha britânica. Um dia, perde-se da dona e mistura-se com um bando de cães de todo o género e sem um centésimo do seu pedigree… Só que nessa epopeia fora da proteção e luxo do palácio real, Rex vai apaixonar-se e encontrar a sua verdadeira natureza…

programme.title: Visões
programme.desc: Piloto profissional de uma companhia aérea de topo, Estelle vive uma vida perfeita com o seu marido Guillaume, até ao dia em que, num corredor do aeroporto, se cruza com Ana, uma fotógrafa com quem teve um romance apaixonado há 20 anos, e que a vai lançar numa espiral de pesadelos.

programme.title: Praxx Fim De Semana
programme.desc: Inverno, sexta-feira. Um grupo de jovens universitários parte para um fim de semana em São João da Cruz, para celebrar a sua ascensão na prestigiada Associação da Vida Académica. A diversão dos jovens acaba por dar lugar ao terror quando à noite, na Praia da Cruz, um ritual de praxe é levado ao limite.

programme.title: 13 Minutos
programme.desc: Quatro famílias numa cidade do centro dos EUA são testadas num único dia, quando um tornado devastador atinge a localidade. Quando a sirene toca, a comunidade tem apenas 13 minutos para chegar aos abrigos. Caminhos irão cruzar-se, vidas serão irreversivelmente alteradas, e a cidade será arrasada…

programme.title: O Melhor Homem
programme.desc: Um grupo de mercenários toma o controlo do hotel de um resort remoto durante um casamento e cabe ao padrinho, ao noivo e ao seu melhor amigo bêbado tentarem deter os terroristas e salvar os reféns.

programme.title: Jogo Da Apanhada
programme.desc: Há trinta anos que um grupo de amigos de infância joga todos os anos a mesma partida de apanhada, sem regras nem fronteiras. Este ano estão decididos a apanhar o único que nunca foi tocado — e que planeia reformar-se invicto no dia do seu casamento.

programme.title: Plano De Fuga 2: Hades
programme.desc: Anos após a espetacular fuga de Ray Breslin da prisão, um dos elementos da sua nova força de segurança de elite desaparece no interior de uma cadeia ilegal chamada Hades, onde os prisioneiros são forçados a lutar entre si. A única forma de o libertar vai ser entrar lá para dentro também.

programme.title: Emboscada
programme.desc: Durante a guerra do Vietname, um grupo de comandos de elite americanos, liderados pelo Capitão Drummond, são encarregues de recolher informação altamente confidencial numa missão arriscada que poderá mudar por completo o rumo do conflito.

programme.title: Waxman O Atirador
programme.desc: Waxman é um ex-soldado das Forças Especiais que está agora a trabalhar como assassino para uma agência governamental ultrassecreta. Quando uma missão num arranha-céus em construção lhe corre terrivelmente mal, Waxman e o seu parceiro Clegg tornam-se os principais alvos a abater.

programme.title: Kickboxer 2: O Regresso
programme.desc: Um ano depois de Kurt Sloane derrotar Tong Po no torneio de kickboxing, o seu irmão David Sloane, que se esforça para manter à tona uma academia de kickboxing em Los Angeles, é forçado a entrar no ringue para uma luta de desforra contra Po.

programme.title: Panamá
programme.desc: Em 1989, numa época de turbulência profunda no Panamá, o ex-marine James Becker chega à paisana ao país para negociar um acordo que envolve armas de fogo, mas acaba por se ver envolvido na invasão americana do país e aprende uma lição fundamental sobre a natureza do poder político.

programme.title: Respect
programme.desc: De criança que cantava no coro da igreja onde o pai era pastor até ao reconhecimento internacional, “Respect” acompanha a notável história de vida da cantora e compositora norte-americana Aretha Franklin e a jornada que efetuou para encontrar sua voz.

programme.title: 10 Minutos
programme.desc: Rex é um mestre do crime que contrata Frank e a sua equipa para roubarem uma joia de valor inestimável. Só que algum deles sabotou o assalto, Frank é agredido e quando volta a si percebe que a joia desapareceu e não se lembra quem o atacou… E vai fazer de tudo para descobrir.

programme.title: Festa De Natal Da Empresa
programme.desc: Perante a ameaça do encerramento da filial da empresa e do corte dos prémios, dois colegas decidem salvar os empregos com uma cartada arriscada: uma festa de Natal épica e sem regras para impressionar um cliente decisivo. O que podia correr mal? Praticamente tudo.

programme.title: À Procura De Uma Estrela
programme.desc: Adam Jones era um chef brilhante que destruiu a carreira nos excessos de Paris. Sóbrio e determinado, chega a Londres decidido a montar a cozinha perfeita e a conquistar a cobiçada terceira estrela Michelin — mesmo que isso teste os limites de todos os que o rodeiam.

programme.title: After Depois Da Verdade
programme.desc: Hardin Scott e Tessa Young estão agora separados. Enquanto Hardin ganha hábitos pouco saudáveis, Tessa consegue o estágio dos seus sonhos, onde chama a atenção do seu novo colega, Trevor, inteligente e responsável… No entanto, Tessa não consegue esquecer Hardin, que é, afinal, o amor da sua vida.

programme.title: Tubarão Branco
programme.desc: Quando um hidroavião aterra numa praia do remoto Recife do Inferno, o desastre acontece e os cinco passageiros ficam presos num bote salva-vidas insuflável, frágil e com abastecimentos limitados. No meio desta confusão, um enorme e furtivo tubarão branco já captou o cheiro deles.

programme.title: Assalto Ao Shopping
programme.desc: Eddie Deacon é um ex-militar que só consegue arranjar emprego como segurança de supermercado. Logo na primeira noite, tem de proteger uma menina que é atacada por mercenários profissionais para a impedirem de testemunhar contra eles.

programme.title: Snitch - Infiltrado
programme.desc: Com o filho adolescente injustamente acusado de tráfico de droga, John Matthews faz um acordo para trabalhar numa perigosa missão como informador infiltrado junto de traficantes, arriscando tudo, incluindo a família e a própria vida.

programme.title: Hércules - A Lenda Começa
programme.desc: Em 1200 a.C, na Grécia Antiga, o príncipe Hércules desconhece que é filho de Zeus e só deseja o amor da Princesa de Creta, prometida em casamento ao seu irmão. Agora, ele vai ter de fazer uma escolha: fugir com o seu verdadeiro amor ou cumprir o seu destino e tornar-se o grande herói do seu tempo.

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: Quando Joe Braven se vê confrontado com um grupo de perigosos traficantes de droga na sua cabana isolada nas montanhas, ele vai ter de fazer tudo o que estiver ao seu alcance para proteger a sua família.

programme.title: Jiu Jitsu
programme.desc: De seis em seis anos, uma antiga ordem de mestres de Jiu Jitsu une forças para enfrentar e derrotar perigosos invasores alienígenas. Mas quando o derradeiro lutador da Terra é derrotado pelo líder dos invasores, o futuro do planeta e da humanidade fica em jogo...

programme.title: Vem Ao Papá
programme.desc: Após receber uma carta enigmática do seu pai, que não vê desde os cinco anos, Norval viaja para ir ter com ele, na esperança de que esta seja uma oportunidade para se reaproximarem. Mas será que se ele soubesse a verdade sombria sobre o seu progenitor, ele o teria reencontrado?

programme.title: Elizabeth Harvest
programme.desc: Elizabeth casa com um brilhante cientista e muda-se para a luxuosa casa dele, onde há apenas um quarto em que é impedida de entrar. Quando ela decide investigar a razão, percebe que o marido pode não ser quem ela pensa.

programme.title: J. S. Bach – Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248
programme.desc: Traditionally, many ensembles festively announce the Christmas season with a performance of Johannes Sebastian Bach’s Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248. It consists of six cantatas originally intended for performance on one of the major feast days of the Christmas period. The work saw its first performance in 1734, at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, where Bach occupied the position of cantor.

programme.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
programme.desc: Stefano Demicheli conducts the Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici and soloists Nicola Cianncio (bass) and Catherine Jones (cello) in a varied baroque music program, recorded at Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Seina in Naples, Italy.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvorák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, 'From the New World'. Composed during Dvorák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 34, KV. 338
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. The concert is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music - five European homes where exquisite works by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Purcell and Marais were played against a backdrop of paintings by Vermeer, Canaletto, and Watteau. Stage direction by Marshall Pynkoski and narrated by Blair Williams.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky – Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek.

programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo.

programme.title: Schumann - Novelletten, Op. 21
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Novelletten, Op. 21. The eight pieces for piano that make up this song cycle are often performed separately. It bears a dedication to pianist Adolph Henselt.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondrácek as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Liszt Mosaics- II
programme.desc: This dance concert - performed in the languages of both music and movement - features, in addition to works by Liszt, some of the finest pieces of Hungary's national romanticism that served to inspire them, antecedents of sacred music reaching as far back as the Gregorian period and compositions by contemporaries who influenced Liszt: Paganini and Chopin. Liszt Mosaics is founded on three thematic pillars.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Veerhavenconcert 2016
programme.desc: On Saturday, August 27, 2016, OVG and Sinfonia Rotterdam presented a new Veerhavenconcert under the direction of Conrad van Alphen. As part of this annual event presented in the port of Rotterdam, the musicians perform on a floating stage, and audiences watch the show on the dock and on boats.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer’s Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Triple Concerto, Op. 56 And Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 And Elgar’s Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music.

programme.title: Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: The exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s La Valse, in an arrangement for two pianos. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Debussy - La Mer
programme.desc: Claude Debussy’s symphonic sketches for orchestra known collectively as ‘La Mer’ evoke a richly varied vision of the sea. The first part (‘De l’aube á midi sur la mer’) calls up a morning and afternoon at sea, the second (‘Jeux de vagues’) echoes the play of the waves, and the third and final part (‘Dialogue du vent et de la mer’) conjures the communing voices of wind and waves.

programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin’s symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928).

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Elias Ackerley
programme.desc: Pianist Elias Ackerley (United Kingdom/South Korea, 2001) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro molto moderato, of Gabriel Fauré’s Piano Quartet No. 1 in C minor, Op. 15.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, also known as “A New Sacred Oratorio”, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This is one of Handel's best-known works, which took only three weeks to compose this oratorio and its famous 'Hallelujah'. The work has immense popularity since its premiere in Dublin in 1742, and is often presented at Easter.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 And 10
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Brahms Tragic Overture And Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2013 - Prague
programme.desc: Every year since 1991, the Berliner Philharmoniker has given concerts in a different European city on each May 1st. These concerts have become known as ‘Europakonzert’. Every guest city has its own special cultural importance. These concerts have served two purposes: to commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra’s founding on May 1st, 1882, and to celebrate the common heritage of the Old World.

programme.title: Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace I
programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads his Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), I’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and tar, a traditional plucked string instrument of Persian music, played here by Saeed Mirzazadeh. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 And 10
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Verdi - Nabucco
programme.desc: Israeli-born conductor Daniel Oren leads the Orchestra of the Arena di Verona in a magnificent interpretation of Giuseppe Verdi's Nabucco.

programme.title: The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Voz News
programme.desc: VOZ NEWS es el noticiero estelar de VOZ, con las principales noticias del país y del mundo, seguidas por un análisis en profundidad de temas destacados de la jornada. El ciclo es presentado por la reconocida periodista televisiva Karina Yapor, acompañada de un equipo de destacados periodistas y de analistas políticos, económicos y sociales.

programme.title: Sid Roth - ¡Es Sobrenatural!
programme.desc: Sid Roth, un judío creyente en Jesús, ha pasado más de 35 años investigando la cualidad sobrenatural de Dios. Él quiere guiarte para que tengas una relación íntima con Dios y camines en milagros.

programme.title: Joni Table Talk
programme.desc: Descubre cómo Dios puede guiarte a través de temporadas turbulentas. La autora best-seller Joni Lamb nos habla de su último libro, Through the Storm (A Través de la Tormenta), una historia de fe inquebrantable para llenarte de esperanza para el futuro.

programme.title: El cielo en la Tierra
programme.desc: Predicación de la Iglesia Cristiana 'El Lugar de su Presencia' en Bogotá, Colombia, Latinoamérica. Con temas relevantes y prácticos, aplicables a la vida diaria y consejos bíblicos para alentar, animar y reflexionar en toda situación.

programme.title: Dios de Milagros
programme.desc: Experimente el poder de Dios en su vida y prepárese para recibir sanidad, restauración, y milagros mientras recibe una palabra llena de unción y poder predicada por el pastor Hernan Castaño desde la Iglesia Ríos De Aceite en Houston, Texas a las naciones. Su vida no será la misma!

programme.title: Impactando las Naciones

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como são feitos objetos como Galaktoboureko, absorvedores de dióxido de carbono e velas favo de mel?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é feito o kimchi ou os soalhos de parquet?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é feita a comida crua para cães? Ou as réplicas de luzes da polícia?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 25
programme.desc: Veja como são feitos os objetos do nosso quotidiano, conheça os métodos e os materiais com que são feitos e saiba mais sobre os processos de produção envolvidos.

programme.desc: Drew e Tee partem na sua primeira viagem a França, visitando um castelo do séc. XVI na região do Loire. Param nos mercados de antiguidades de Montsoreau e Viarme.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T12 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Quando outras empresas mudam com os tempos, Drew vê a oportunidade de comprar artigos que outros não querem. Em Essex, vê uma mesa rara de 1930 numa Department Store em fecho.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T11 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Em Margate, Drew consegue um bom negócio num 'império de sucata' gerido por alguns dos seus melhores contactos. Numa mansão georgiana em Fife encontra uma pechincha surpreendente.

programme.title: Restauradores De Casas De Campo: A Construir Em Itália T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A família Morrill assume a responsabilidade de uma renovação da cozinha. Chase descobre pedreiros locais e abraça o lado artístico dos miúdos.

programme.title: Restauradores De Casas De Campo: A Construir Em Itália T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Chase e a família assumem o projeto mais ambicioso de Balcony House, transformando os antigos estábulos numa nova sala de estar para a família.

programme.title: Os Milhões De Escobar T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Após umas quantas buscas dececionantes em e nos arredores de Medellin, Popeye leva Ben e Doug à Hacienda El Oro, uma das propriedades de Pablo na selva.

programme.title: Conspirações E Segredos T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Andrew investiga a teoria sobre uma arma na Venezuela associada a ataques contra funcionários norte-americanos no estrangeiro e à síndrome de Havana.

programme.title: Conspirações E Segredos T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Andrew investiga a morte de Epstein, recriando a cena do crime enquanto procura provas de suicídio, homicídio ou algo bem pior.

programme.title: Desaparecimentos Misteriosos Com Terry O'Quinn T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Em 2014, o voo MH370 da Malasya Airlines desapareceu sem deixar rasto. Terá caído? E, se caiu, porque é que os destroços não conseguem ser encontrados?

programme.title: Desaparecimentos Misteriosos Com Terry O'Quinn T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O desaparecimento da Atlântida é um dos mais famosos de sempre. Milhares de anos depois, será a tecnologia de ponta capaz de desvendar este mistério antigo?

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os sobreviventes correm para encontrar água e um lugar para passar a primeira noite, abrigados dos predadores e do frio do Chaco argentino.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T7 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: A chuva torrencial atinge os sobreviventes assim que caem na floresta tropical da Geórgia. O par cria uma ligação que leva a uma decisão que pode mudar vidas.

programme.title: Texas Metal T4 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Bill e a equipa personalizam um F-450 King Ranch de 2021. Instalam-lhe uma inovadora e maior suspensão, uma grelha pintada e um reboque personalizado.

programme.title: Aquários XXL T8 - Ep. 11

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T1 - Ep. 8

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T2 - Ep. 2

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T2 - Ep. 3

programme.title: Regresso Às Origens T1 - Ep. 16

programme.title: Regresso Às Origens T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Os Raneys chegam ao Missouri para conhecer uma família que sobreviveu a um tornado. Para além de viverem numa cabana a cair aos pedaços, não têm qualquer fonte de água potável.

programme.title: Regresso Às Origens T1 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Os Raneys salvam um rancho no Oregon, situado no fundo de um penhasco que o separa de quatro acres de terra necessários para o gado e para arranjar comida.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 107
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 37
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 95
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 56
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 91
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 51
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 54
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Kim Hoorweg at BIRD, Rotterdam
programme.desc: After Dutch singer Kim Hoorweg landed her first record contract from Universal Music at the age of 14, her musical career took off and she became a well-known name in the Netherlands jazz community. Famous artists such as Candy Dulfer, Raul Midón, Metropole Orkest, and Gino Vannelli, to name a few, have already performed with the singer on numerous occasions.

programme.title: Schloss Ansbach: Ornette Coleman Sextet
programme.desc: ‘Harmolodics’, the musical philosophy of jazz saxophonist Ornette Coleman, is associated primarily with avant-garde jazz and the free jazz movement, although its implications extend beyond these limits. Coleman defined ‘harmolodics’ as “the use of the physical and the mental of one's own logic made into an expression of sound to bring about the musical sensation of unison executed by a single person or with a group”.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Straight No Chaser
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Sonny Sharrock - Peanut
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía And Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1978, the famed Chicago Blues All Star Band put on an electrifying performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Mark Guiliana
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Rumble
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Marius Neset - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. In 2019, one of them is Copenhagen-based Norwegian saxophonist Marius Neset, who is known internationally for his collaborations with People Are Machines, Kaktusch, JazzKamikaze, and Django Bates' projects StoRMChaser and Human Chain.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis Quintet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis and his quintet performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: Natalia M. King
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Münchner Klaviersommer: Eliane Elias Trio
programme.desc: There’s no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil’, seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards’, and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards’ in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Carlinhos Brown
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: VEIN Plays Ravel
programme.desc: A sound support with provocative combinations, a modern music laboratory, a vehicle of inspiration whose importance has been proven by many high-profile collaborations. Music lovers who appreciate jazz for its ability to provoke and continuously question the status quo certainly do not expect that such a standard set in its configuration finds itself completely detached from tradition.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: BIRDtv: Orlando Julius
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Mahavishnu Orchestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty’, pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: LBT - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. Among the artists of 2019 is the German Leo Betzl Trio.

programme.title: Spiral
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 And 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: II
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Stranger than Paranoia
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1994, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Liran Donin - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, Tel Aviv-born bass player, producer and composer Liran Donin appeared here.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks And Company - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Kyle Eastwood Quintet
programme.desc: Bassist Kyle Eastwood (1968) is an explorer, equally at ease with jazz melodies as with pop songs. In the late 1970s, his father Clint took him to see his first jazz concert - a Count Basie performance. Eastwood Jr. was in awe of the drummer and wanted to play an instrument himself. It so happened he wasn’t so much interested in jazz, preferring rhythm and blues, Motown and Stax records, funk groups, and North African and Indian music.

programme.title: Songs She Never Heard
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Verônica Ferriani
programme.desc: Verônica Ferriani is a Brazilian singer and songwriter recognized for her powerful voice and distinctive musical identity. Her career spans a variety of styles within MPB (Brazilian Popular Music), and she stands out for the intensity and emotion of her performances. In her shows, Verônica presents a mix of works inspired by personal experiences, tributes to her major influences, and selections from her own compositions.

programme.title: Guitarlegend Wes Montgomery in The Netherlands
programme.desc: Wes Montgomery: Live in '65 shines a light on one of the most unique and influential guitarists in music history. These beautifully filmed programs from the spring of 1965 feature Wes, in intimate studio settings, leading three different lineups through some of his best-known tunes, including “Four On Six”, “Jingles”, and “West Coast Blues”.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Sunrise
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Gil Evans, Ornette Coleman - Schloss Ansbach
programme.desc: This program presents two concerts from Schloss Ansbach in 1978. The first concert features Gil Evans and his orchestra, consisting of Gil Evans on piano, Steve Lacy on soprano saxophone, Arthur Blythe on alto saxophone, Pit Levin on synthesizers, Earl McIntyre on trombone, Lewis Soloff on trumpet, Geoffrey Berlin on bass and Sue Evans on percussion instruments.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Red Earth
programme.desc: American jazz singer and Grammy-winner Dee Dee Bridgewater embarks on a journey through Mali in search of her musical and spiritual roots. Assisted by producer Cheick Tidiane Seck, Dee Dee sets out to discover the ‘traditional’ music of the country, and to collaborate with singers, drummers, ngoni and kora players.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: 'Long Tall Dexter' Live in '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64?features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.title: Brooks Bowman/Jazzmeia Horn, East Of The Sun
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: Ça Commence aujourd'hui
programme.desc: Le syndrome de Gilles de la Tourette reste l’un des troubles neurologiques les plus mal connus et les plus caricaturés. Tics moteurs, cris, gestes involontaires, parfois insultes incontrôlées : derrière l’image souvent moquée, il y a surtout une réalité beaucoup plus complexe, faite d’angoisse, de fatigue, de honte parfois… mais aussi de force, de famille et de résistance au regard des autres.

programme.title: Poulet Mania
programme.desc: Ecrit et réalisé par Katia Chapoutier Une production Program 33 avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2026 Chouchou de nos assiettes, le poulet s’est hissé au rang de viande la plus consommée en France en 2024. Rôti le dimanche, nuggets de cantine, wings de fast-food ou blanc grillé dans une salade healthy, il existe sous toutes les formes et pour tous les goûts.

programme.title: Dora, la Jeune Loutre Géante
programme.desc: Documentaire produit par Blue Ant Media Inc. 2022. Un film de Ruth Harries. Une famille de loutres géantes vit sur les rives de la rivière Vermelho, au Brésil. Les quatre petits sortent de leur tanière pour la première fois. Ils vont devoir rapidement devenir d'excellents nageurs, capables d'attraper leur propre repas.

programme.title: L'île de Vancouver, un Paradis Sauvage
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Wall to Wall Media Ltd. 2023. Réalisation : Alex Burr, Tessa Chan, Ruth Campbell Des tropiques à l’Arctique, l’isolement et la vie entre terre et mer font des îles de véritables laboratoires naturels de la vie sauvage. L’histoire de leurs origines est essentielle pour découvrir leur impact sur les animaux qui tentent de survivre sur ces territoires.

programme.title: Queensland, L’australie Tropicale
programme.desc: Réalisateur : Franck Decluzet Un documentaire produit par Ampersand. L’Australie, à la fois une île et un continent, déroule des milliers de kilomètres de littoral bordés par les océans Indien et Pacifique. Ce voyage nous emmène dans l'Etat du Queensland, le long de la côte est bordée par la mer de Corail.

programme.title: Les Routes de l'impossible - Burundi, Débrouille à haut Risque
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Tony Comiti Productions avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2024. Réalisation : Daniel Lainé et Julien Boluen. Dans les pays dont certaines régions sont très difficiles d'accès, cette série part à la rencontre de celles et ceux qui bravent tous les dangers au péril de leur vie. Pour eux, franchir ces routes de l'impossible est le seul moyen de gagner de quoi subsister.

programme.desc: Os agentes encontram um corpo estrangulado em chamas num liceu da Geórgia, desencadeando uma longa busca pela justiça. Na Carolina do Sul, um estudante universitário desaparece.

programme.title: Good Cop, Bad Cop T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Resolver um assassinato já é difícil, mas o que acontece quando os detetives são confrontados com um criminoso que sabe estar um passo à frente? Um assassino com um distintivo.

programme.title: Good Cop, Bad Cop T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: O assassínio de um imigrante sírio diligente em Jacksonville, na Florida, revela um historial de roubo e violência de vários anos que choca a polícia.

programme.title: Disappeared T2 - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Os pais de Bradyn entram em pânico quando não o conseguem contactar e descobrem que ele levou uma caçadeira. Agora têm de descobrir do que foge e para onde vai.

programme.title: Disappeared T2 - Ep. 25
programme.desc: Tom fica desesperado quando a sua esposa desaparece. Mas quando o patrão dela diz à Polícia que duvida do carácter de Tom, este passa a ser suspeito.

programme.title: The Shadows Of Death T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Debra Coffey e Melissa Lewis trabalham na mesma firma de advocacia. Quando o corpo de Melissa é encontrado num canal, Debra sente-se culpada quando um segredo é revelado.

programme.title: The Shadows Of Death T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Os Shahanazaris mudaram-se do Irão para a Califórnia. Quando o filho mais novo da família é morto durante um assalto, os irmãos receiam que a culpa seja dele mesmo.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Um veículo abandonado e com sangue leva os detetives a pensar em homicídio. A investigação leva-os à pompa da Florida e a um suspeito improvável.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Em Orinda, Califórnia, as «Bobbies» funcionam como uma irmandade de liceu. Quando alguém assassina uma das suas, todas as Bobbies são suspeitas.

programme.title: Swamp Murders T5 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Dois adolescentes são mortos a tiro, em plena luz do dia, numa praia remota da Flórida. Sem pistas, o caso acaba por se resolver na sequência de um telefonema inesperado.

programme.title: Swamp Murders T5 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Shawn Williams, uma mamã de 22 anos, vai à mercearia e nunca regressa. O seu corpo é encontrado no dia seguinte, num rio. Resta saber se Shawn conhecia o seu assassino.

programme.title: The Dead Files T10 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: No Ohio, Steve e Amy ajudam um homem que acha que há algo na sua propriedade que está a atacar a sua mãe. Amy lança a hipótese de a terra estar amaldiçoada.

programme.title: Conjuring Kesha T1 - Ep. 4

programme.title: A Última Tentativa De Hitler T6 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Um batalhão americano isolado luta para defender uma posição estratégica nas montanhas de Itália, conhecida como «Battle Mountain». Todavia, os alemães não estão dispostos a ceder terreno sem dar luta.

programme.title: A Última Tentativa De Hitler T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O Primeiro Exército canadiano passa semanas a limpar a Península Scheldt, na Holanda, como parte do esforço dos Aliados para abrir o porto em Antuérpia. A 1 de novembro de 1944, os Calgary Highlanders atacam uma ponte fortemente protegida. Trata-se de uma manobra de diversão. Com os alemães distraídos, os Comandos Aliados realizam um ataque anfíbio à Ilha Walcheren, a última fortaleza nazi que vigia o porto.

programme.title: A Última Tentativa De Hitler T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Março de 1945. Enquanto os exércitos aliados se posicionam ao longo do Rio Reno para invadir a Alemanha nazi, os generais esforçam-se por ser os primeiros a atravessar. Hitler ordenou que nenhuma ponte ficasse nas mãos dos Aliados.

programme.title: Obras Incríveis T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Deixe-se maravilhar por uma das mais incríveis e notáveis obras de engenharia do mundo.

programme.title: Obras Incríveis: O Superestádio Do Real Madrid - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Considerado um verdadeiro templo para os adeptos do Real Madrid, entramos na renovação de vanguarda do emblemático estádio da equipa madrilena, o Santiago Bernabéu. Transformar o monótono edifício de betão com uma fachada metálica futurista, um teto retrátil, um painel de vídeo de 360º e um revolucionário sistema de relvado subterrâneo – ao mesmo tempo que recebe os jogos – vai desafiar os limites da engenharia.

programme.title: Apocalipse Da Segunda Guerra Mundial T1 - Ep. 5

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T1 - Ep. 2
